prefixItems.const: Decoded response text encoded as UTF-8 SHA256 binds the requested capture and indices, not compressed or TLS wire bytes; integrity is not source authentication or rights clearance.
Capture origin, source URL and receipt are caller-supplied provenance, not independently verified transport observations.

Absolute ordinals follow captured units member order then array row order, a capture convention not financial chronology. Numeric lexemes are retained; no latest, restatement or fiscal-period inference occurs.
Date-only labels are not publication instants. Caller-selected calendar guards do not establish publication availability.
No canonical metric, financial candidate, accounting basis, security identity or eligibility is produced. Source text is supplied separately.

enum: Capture-bound selected evidence is not a canonical fact, an authenticated source, or an eligible metric input.
Original capture SHA256 binds decoded response text encoded as UTF-8 to independent caller expectations; it is not a signature, authenticated transport, compressed HTTP bytes, or rights clearance.
Capture metadata and supplied submissions DTO remain caller assertions. The submissions hash covers only a validated DTO, not its original HTTP body.
Numeric lexeme, source ordinals, unit and period labels are preserved without conversion, scaling, accounting-basis inference, aggregation or semantic role binding.
Exact uniqueness applies only to the supplied capture slice and bounded submissions subset; there is no latest, restatement, complete-history or publication-availability inference.
Date labels, acceptance timestamps and constituent receipts do not prove publication availability. Calendar timezone remains caller-selected and unverified.
Persisted verification must reconstruct from separately retained independent inputs and original capture text; embedded expectations and successful flags are not trusted.

$comment: STRUCTURE ONLY. This schema cannot establish source authentication, captured-body/independent-input reconstruction, exact chronology, local uniqueness, ordinal/filing joins, hostile-input bounds, or persisted equality. Always call selectSecCaptureFinancialEvidence or verifySecCaptureFinancialEvidenceCandidate with independent inputs and original text. The candidate is NOT a canonical financial fact and metric_eligible must remain false.
